observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 165.» (L7) and «p. 166.» (L32) in the right margin. A dot stands before the line number 5; it is not a sign. In the locator «p. 166.» the last two figures are printed blotted.
body L13, L23, notes_left L2: «dig.» (digiti) is printed small and raised after the number; in note 2 its letters are printed broken (the g like an s).
body L18, notes_left L2: «10ᵖ» and «60ᵖ» are written with a small raised italic p (partes).
body L15, L29, L41: a speck stands over the second e of «provenerat», a blot at the top of the space between «denique» and «eclipsis», and a dot under the t of «prout»; they are not signs.
notes_left L4: the n of «nutorum» is printed filled at the top, like a D.
body L6, L17: specks stand over the r of «residuum» and over the first i of «trianguli»; they are not signs.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
